note: Every target below is a PROPOSAL for discussion. None is agreed, none is enforced, and no alerting exists for any of them. 'measured_by' names what can be measured today; 'not instrumented' means nothing measures it yet.
binding: Correctness-sensitive systems (billing, authentication) prioritise integrity over availability; live transport prioritises continuity, with eventual control-plane convergence.

categories.name: Identity login and token exchange
categories.sli: Share of POST /oauth/token and sign-in requests that answer without a 5xx; p95 latency of token issuance.
categories.integrity_rule: A token is never issued with a capability that was not granted; refusing is always preferred to issuing wrongly.

categories.name: Public page availability
categories.sli: Share of GET requests to server-rendered public pages that answer without a 5xx.

categories.name: Control APIs
categories.sli: Share of authenticated write/control API requests (stream settings, object writes, subscriptions, jobs) that answer without a 5xx; p95 latency.
measured_by: each service: http_requests_total and http_request_duration_seconds by route template

categories.name: Chat message persistence and delivery
categories.sli: Share of accepted chat messages that are persisted and delivered to connected viewers; delivery delay.
categories.measurement_status: not instrumented: Live exposes live_ws_connections only; no per-message persistence or delivery counter exists yet

categories.name: Ingest acceptance
categories.sli: Share of publish attempts (RTMP, WHIP, WebRTC, SRT) with a valid key that are accepted.

proposed_target.accepted: 99.5% of valid publish attempts over 30 days

categories.measurement_status: not instrumented: no publish-attempt counter exists yet

categories.name: Active stream continuity
categories.sli: Share of live streams that end by the broadcaster's action rather than by a server restart, deploy or crash.
categories.measurement_status: partly instrumented: the number of live streams is measured; the cause of each stream end is not recorded

categories.name: Media upload and processing
categories.sli: Share of uploads and recordings that reach ready (never silently lost); time from upload or stream end to ready.
categories.measurement_status: partly instrumented: states are counted; time-to-ready is not measured

categories.name: Ledger settlement correctness
categories.sli: Share of settlements whose journal balances and reconciles with the provider; duplicate monetary effects.
categories.measurement_status: not instrumented by this change (Billing is owned by another track)

categories.name: Event delivery latency
categories.sli: Time from an event's acceptance to its successful delivery to each subscriber; dead-letter depth.

categories.name: Developer API availability
categories.sli: Share of public developer API requests (registry, JWKS, events pull, object API) that answer without a 5xx.
measured_by: each service: http_requests_total by route template
